raw_segments.text: A black nose, that means he'll be fierce, a good house dog," Kalia observed gravely
and stolidly, as if the only thing he cared about was the puppy and its black nose.
But in reality, he still had to do his utmost to control his feelings not to burst out crying
like a child and do what he would he could not control it.
When it grows up, you'll have to keep it on the chain, I'm sure.
